en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑storey institutional building with a steep, complex roof, towers, dormers, and many windows. The structure is set behind open fields in the foreground and appears to be part of a larger school or campus complex extending to the left with additional buildings and a church‑like tower visible in the background. Printed captions in red at the top identify the location and the name of the school.
